nodes.name: Design
nodes.description: The intentional planning and shaping of objects, communications, environments, and experiences.

nodes.name: Graphic Design
nodes.description: Visual communication through typography, imagery, and layout.

nodes.name: Typography
nodes.description: The art of arranging type for legibility and expression.

nodes.name: Logo Design
nodes.description: Design of distinctive marks identifying an organization.

nodes.name: Branding
nodes.description: Creating a coherent visual identity system for an entity.

nodes.name: Editorial Design
nodes.description: Design of books, magazines, and publications.

nodes.name: Poster Design
nodes.description: Design of large-format printed announcements.

nodes.name: Packaging Design
nodes.description: Design of product containers and packaging graphics.

nodes.name: Publication Design
nodes.description: The overall design of multi-page printed works.

nodes.name: Advertising Design
nodes.description: Design of persuasive visual communications for marketing.

nodes.name: Industrial Design
nodes.description: Design of mass-produced physical products for function and usability.

nodes.name: Product Design
nodes.description: The design of consumer and commercial products.

nodes.name: Furniture Design
nodes.description: The design of chairs, tables, and furnishings.

nodes.name: Transportation Design
nodes.description: The design of vehicles and mobility systems.

nodes.name: Consumer Electronics Design
nodes.description: The design of electronic devices for consumers.

nodes.name: Interior Design
nodes.description: Design of interior spaces for function, safety, and aesthetics.

nodes.name: Residential Interior Design
nodes.description: Interior design of homes and dwellings.

nodes.name: Commercial Interior Design
nodes.description: Interior design of retail, office, and hospitality spaces.

nodes.name: User Experience Design
nodes.description: Design of digital products focused on how users feel and interact.

nodes.name: User Interface Design
nodes.description: Design of the visual and interactive surface of software.

nodes.name: Interaction Design
nodes.description: Design of the behaviors and responses of interactive systems.

nodes.name: Information Architecture
nodes.description: The structuring and labeling of information in digital products.

nodes.name: Service Design
nodes.description: Design of end-to-end service experiences across touchpoints.

nodes.name: Usability
nodes.description: The study and practice of making products easy and efficient to use.

nodes.name: Design Research
nodes.description: User and context research informing design decisions.

nodes.name: Web Design
nodes.description: Design of websites and web applications.

nodes.name: Type Design
nodes.description: The design of typefaces and font families.

nodes.name: Design Thinking
nodes.description: A human-centered problem-solving methodology of ideation and prototyping.

nodes.name: Sustainable Design
nodes.description: Design minimizing environmental impact across a product's lifecycle.

nodes.name: Universal Design
nodes.description: Design usable by the widest range of people regardless of ability.

nodes.name: Communication Design
nodes.description: Design of messages and information across media.
